text: Mara traces each of the 5 accounts back to the exact event that created its access, using Entra ID audit logs and AWS CloudTrail, filtered to the OT and SCADA boundary's admin role and policy.

All 5 show the same pattern: direct access created on the same date, fourteen months earlier, authorized by Hartwell's documented break-glass emergency-access procedure -- during the Substation 12 outage.

Break-glass requires revocation within 72 hours of resolution. The outage ticket closed as resolved. No follow-up ticket to revoke the 5 responders' access was ever opened. The outage ended. The access didn't.
This is the exact weakness R-03 already named in Hartwell's risk register -- a break-glass procedure with no automatic expiration. A sequence of reasonable actions, not one person's mistake.
